description: React component for managing model aliases, including adding, editing, deleting, and displaying alias configurations with UI elements and notifications.

classes.name: ModelAliasManager
classes.description: React functional component for managing model aliases with state and UI controls.

methods.name: handleAddAlias
methods.description: Adds a new alias after validation, updates state, and notifies parent.

methods.name: handleEditAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias to be edited.

methods.name: handleUpdateAlias
methods.description: Validates and saves the edited alias, updates state, and notifies parent.

methods.name: deleteAlias
methods.description: Removes an alias by ID, updates state, and notifies parent.
